differences.reason: The app refuses to stream a track to a request that carries no credentials. Jellyfin streams it.
Transcoding is switched off in these tests, so a request for MP3 gets the FLAC file as it is. Jellyfin converts it.
Transcoding is switched off in these tests, so PlaybackInfo offers no transcode where Jellyfin offers MP3. With an ffmpeg the app sends both keys (compat_jellyfin_library).
As TranscodingUrl: no transcode is offered while transcoding is switched off in these tests.
